faq.title: Clear answers before you pay.
faq.subtitle: Hardware, bans, and access—without marketing fluff.

items.q: Where do I check if the loader is current?
items.a: Read cheatsapexlegends.org after an Apex Legends or Javelin update. A banner from yesterday is not a current build. Leave the loader closed until the page matches this client.

items.q: Apex Legends just patched. When do I open the loader?
items.a: Read the status page after that client build, and after every hotfix, before you launch. A saved config from an older build is not a current check. A ban is still possible.
items.aHtml: Read the status page after that client build, and after every hotfix, before you launch. A saved config from an older build is not a current check. A ban is still possible.

items.q: What happens after I buy?
items.a: Checkout opens the portal with the loader for the product you paid for. Save a config after you tune it. HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot stay on.

items.q: Can I get banned?
items.a: Yes. EA Javelin can act on the account. Nothing on this site is a guarantee that a session stays clean.

items.q: What is an HWID flag, and does the cheat key fix it?
items.a: A hardware flag follows the PC. New accounts can fail on that machine and work on another. That is the HWID Spoofer, sold separately. It does not undo an account-only restriction, and lifetime on the menu does not include it.

items.q: Which PCs are supported?
items.a: Windows 10 and 11 with HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot on. Use the latest Apex Legends PC client. macOS and Linux are not supported.

items.q: Can I move a key to another PC?
items.a: Open support with the order email. A machine that fails new accounts is an HWID Spoofer purchase, not a free move of the cheat key.

items.q: What is for sale?
items.a: the menu and the HWID Spoofer are listed on the products page. The menu is $35 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. The HWID spoofer is $50 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. They are separate checkouts.

items.q: Does $150 lifetime include the spoofer?
items.a: No. Lifetime on the Apex hack menu is that product only. The HWID spoofer is a separate key with its own $50 and $150 plans. A shorter plan does not promise a credit toward lifetime.

items.q: What does Player ESP show in Apex Legends?
items.a: Player ESP marks enemy and squad legends with labels in your view. Pair it with Distance ESP or Box ESP if the screen feels crowded.

items.q: How do I tune Advanced Aimbot?
items.a: Start with a low FOV and higher smoothness, then add Weapon ESP so you know what range the fight is at. Visible checks stay on until you know how the preset behaves.

items.q: Why use Weapon ESP?
items.a: Weapon ESP shows the gun a legend is holding before you commit to a push—useful when teams swap between close and long fights.

items.q: Do Health Bar and shield readouts stack?
items.a: Health Bar shows shield and health together on marked legends. Turn down Distance ESP if bars overlap during end circles.

items.q: How does Loot ESP help between zones?
items.a: Loot ESP highlights ground gear and tier filters so you can sprint from cover to upgrades without guessing what is on the floor.

items.q: What does No Recoil change?
items.a: No Recoil eases kick on ARs, SMGs, and LMGs. It does not replace crosshair placement—tune it after Advanced Aimbot feels stable.

items.q: What does EA Javelin Bypass mean?
items.a: The loader is built to run with EA Javelin active on the Apex Legends PC client. It is not a guarantee against bans or flags—read the status page after each update.

items.q: Is Stream Proof safe for every broadcast setup?
items.a: Stream Proof targets common capture apps. Results still vary by GPU, overlay stack, and OBS settings—test offline before you go live.

items.q: How do I reach 24/7 Support?
items.a: Use the Discord link from checkout or the support page. Include your order email and whether the issue is the menu or the HWID spoofer.

items.q: When is the HWID spoofer the right buy?
items.a: Use HWID Spoofer when a new account fails on one PC and works on another. It does not fix an account-only restriction on the same machine.

items.q: Is this a DMA card?
items.a: No. The Apex hack is a Windows loader from checkout. A DMA device is a different product and is not what this key delivers.

items.q: Are blog guides official product documentation?
items.a: Articles explain workflows and link to the menu. The feature list on that page is the checkout source of truth.

items.q: Need help applying this guide?
items.a: Open support with your order email and the article title. Include the exact loader text if something fails.

items.q: Will settings in this article work next patch?
items.a: Re-check after every Apex Legends or Javelin update. Reload a saved config instead of copying old slider values from a post.

items.q: Which plan should I start with?
items.a: Start with the 31-day key if you want to try one product before paying once. The menu is $35 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. The HWID spoofer is $50 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. A shorter plan does not include a credit toward lifetime, and a lifetime key on one product does not include the others.

items.q: Can I upgrade a 31-day key to lifetime?
items.a: There is no automatic upgrade. Lifetime is a separate checkout on the same product. The $35 or $50 you already paid is not credited toward the $150 lifetime price.

items.q: What happens when a plan expires?
items.a: A 31-day key stops when that period ends. Buy another 31-day key or a lifetime key on that same product to keep access. Lifetime does not renew. An expired key does not move to a different product.

items.q: Where do I check the current loader status?
items.a: Read the status page before you launch. Updated means the note was refreshed. It is not a claim that a session stays clean.

updates.title: 22 maggio 2026 — Aggiornamento Javelin incentrato su DMA
updates.summary: ha preso di mira le configurazioni di accesso diretto alla memoria SATA/NVMe esterne e i relativi bypass del firmware. La discussione pubblica si è concentrata sul blocco IOMMU Windows e sulla rimappatura DMA delle DLL di dispositivi malevoli. ha affermato che l'hardware legittimo non viene fisicamente distrutto; le configurazioni illecite di cheat config possono fallire su quel PC. Questo negozio vende un loader Windows, non una scheda DMA. Il post del blog “Cronologia della sicurezza di Javelin (2026)” riassume le stesse date.

updates.summary: VERDE significa che questa nota elenca il file corrente da caricare. ROSSO significa attendere. Leggi questa pagina dopo un aggiornamento di Apex Legends o Javelin prima di avviare. L'etichetta non è una dichiarazione di invulnerabilità e non significa che un match rimarrà pulito.

updates.title: Cosa copre il menu
updates.summary: Il menu pubblicato elenca Opzioni Aimbot, Opzioni visive giocatore, Opzioni visive mondo e Opzioni varie. Il tasto di scelta rapida Modalità combattimento nasconde abilità e ESP trappola. Non rimuove il rischio Javelin.

updates.title: Requisiti PC
updates.summary: Windows 10 o 11, Intel Core i5 o AMD Ryzen 5 o superiore e l'ultimo client Apex Legends PC. Lascia attivi HVCI, Core Isolation, TPM e Secure Boot.

updates.title: “Aggiornato” non è una dichiarazione di invulnerabilità
updates.summary: Aggiornato significa che questa nota è stata rinfrescata. Non significa che il loader sia immune ai rilevamenti e non significa che un match rimarrà pulito dopo il prossimo aggiornamento di Javelin o del gioco.

updates.title: I piani rimangono su schede separate
updates.summary: Il menu è $35 for 31 days o $150 lifetime. Il HWID spoofer è $50 for 31 days o $150 lifetime. Una chiave lifetime su un prodotto non include l'altro.
